title: ctenodon riedelianus
intro: Ctenodon riedelianus, commonly known as the "Brazilian ironwood" or "Brazilian rosewood", is a tree species native to the northeastern regions of Brazil. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ctenodon riedelianus include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
